hero.lead: Backend developer growing into DevOps and cloud. I've built microservice projects with Java (Spring) and Python, and I deploy them to the cloud through CI/CD pipelines I set up myself. During my internships, I worked closely on the development and deployment processes of production systems and contributed to them. In my personal projects, I'm gaining hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible (Infrastructure as Code), Docker, AWS, Kubernetes and OpenShift, and I build web and mobile apps with React and React Native.

about.heading: What I bring to a team
pillar.1.title: I think about the whole system
pillar.1.body: I've worked on backends, databases, message queues and deployment. When I build a feature, I also think about how it fails and how it runs in production.
pillar.2.title: I use AI with understanding
pillar.2.body: I don't use AI-generated code I don't understand; I read it, test it and change it when needed.
pillar.3.title: I find the root cause
pillar.3.body: I look for the cause of a bug instead of patching over it. When I learn a new technology, I also learn which problem it solves.
pillar.4.title: I automate repetitive work
pillar.4.body: I automate manual, repeated steps with Python scripts and CI/CD pipelines, which saves time for me and the team.
pillar.5.title: I finish what I take on
pillar.5.body: I deliver my work running and maintainable. I share my technical decisions with the team and adjust them based on feedback.
